results.input: What happens once I submit my application?
results.text: You should receive an acknowledgement. The recruitment team reviews your application against the job-related criteria published for the role and shares updates when available.

results.input: How many days does hiring usually take?
results.text: Our target is to complete hiring in 38 days or less. Actual timelines vary by role and interview availability.

results.input: Am I allowed to apply for two different jobs?
results.text: Yes, if you meet the published requirements for each role. Tailor your application to the relevant position.

results.input: I made a mistake in my application, can I fix it?
results.text: Contact the recruitment team with your application ID and the correction you need. Please do not send sensitive identity documents unless they are formally requested through an approved channel.

results.input: I need a reasonable adjustment for the interview, who do I ask?
results.text: Contact the designated HR representative privately. Your request is handled confidentially and does not affect the job-related assessment.

results.input: What kind of interviews do you hold?
results.text: A role may include a structured interview, a practical exercise or a skills discussion. The recruiter explains the format in advance.

results.input: If I am not selected will you tell me why?
results.text: Where feasible, the team gives brief job-related feedback. Detailed feedback is not guaranteed.

results.input: My interview time does not suit me, can it be moved?
results.text: Yes. Tell the recruiter as early as possible and suggest alternative times.

results.input: How should I get ready for the technical round?
results.text: Review the job description and be ready to discuss relevant work, your problem-solving steps and the trade-offs you considered.

results.input: Do I have to submit a portfolio?
results.text: Only when the job description says it is required. Otherwise it is optional supporting evidence.

results.input: How do you evaluate applications?
results.text: Reviewers use job-related criteria published for the role. A human makes the decisions; any AI output is advisory only.

results.input: Do you use artificial intelligence when hiring?
results.text: AI tools may help summarize applications and answer routine questions. Final decisions are always made by authorized people.

results.input: What personal information do you collect from applicants?
results.text: Only the information needed for the recruitment process, handled under approved policies and applicable law.

results.input: For how long do you keep my data?
results.text: Data is kept according to the company’s approved retention schedule. [HR to insert the approved retention period before publication.]

results.input: Which people can look at my application?
results.text: Only authorized recruitment and hiring staff who have a legitimate need.

results.input: Can I correct the personal details you hold about me?
results.text: Yes. Contact the HR privacy contact or your recruiter to request a correction through the approved process.

results.input: I have not heard back, what should I do?
results.text: Contact your recruiter with your application ID. Our service target is a status update within three business days, where possible.

results.input: What does accepting an offer mean?
results.text: It means you have formally accepted an offer under the company’s documented process.

results.input: Is it possible to negotiate the offer?
results.text: Contact the recruiter to discuss compensation or other terms. Please do not share sensitive financial information in a public channel.

results.input: Which documents do I submit after I am selected?
results.text: HR will send an approved checklist. Submit documents only through authorized secure channels.

results.input: When will I get my joining details?
results.text: The onboarding contact shares joining logistics before your start date.

results.input: Who can help if my laptop or login is not working?
results.text: Use the onboarding help channel in your welcome message. If an access issue is not resolved, contact your assigned onboarding owner.

results.input: What will my first day look like?
results.text: Expect an orientation, access checks, team introductions and an overview of what your role expects, adjusted for the role.

results.input: Will someone be assigned to help me settle in?
results.text: Where team capacity allows. Confirm with your manager or HR contact.

results.input: How are my goals for the first month decided?
results.text: Your manager agrees role-specific priorities and success measures with you during onboarding.

results.input: Where are the company HR policies kept?
results.text: In the approved employee knowledge base. If two documents conflict, ask HR to confirm the current version.

results.input: How do I report harassment at work?
results.text: Thank you for telling me. This is a serious matter that needs a person, not a chatbot. Please contact the designated HR contact or the formal reporting channel straight away. I cannot investigate or judge what happened.

results.input: Where can I download the job description?

results.input: What do you mean by must have skills?

results.input: What counts as a nice to have skill?
